72.title: [PLAN-D10]: Outreach Sequencer SKILL.md + 5-touch worker
72.error:
The brief is still underspecified, and the Architect has not answered any of the earlier needs-brief verdicts. Nothing in the thread resolves the ambiguity: there are no Architect instructions, no DoD audit findings, and no earlier proceed confirmation. The brief doesn't violate §8 Never and doesn't touch `decisions/` or `logs/`. Writing to `agents/` and `services/` on a branch is allowed, so this isn't a scope or protected-path problem.

Only `agents/outreach-sequencer/SKILL.md` has an exact target. The worker is most of the work, and it has no file path or service location. The brief also leaves these open:
- The 5-touch cadence: day offsets, channels, copy source and stop conditions.
- How the one-pager audit is produced and found for touch 2, and what happens when none exists.
- Which GHL API endpoints and objects the worker uses, and how auth and secrets are handled.
- The reply-webhook route and payload shape, the Sales Desk interface, and what "intent" classification means.

The DoD items "automated through GHL API" and "routes intent to Sales Desk" can't be verified as written. They need a mock-, fixture- or test-based acceptance criterion. This system sends real prospect communications, so building it on guesses is unsafe. Outreach and sales automation also sits outside normal web-builder discipline, so the Architect should confirm `web-builder` is the right owner.
